title: UPI Transaction Failed? Ye 3 Steps Mein Paise Wapas Aayenge #shorts
description:
UPI transaction fail ho jaye toh ghabraye nahi. Yeh simple 3 steps follow karke apne paise safe tarike se wapas paayein.

Sources (Wikipedia, CC BY-SA):
- Unified Payments Interface: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unified_Payments_Interface
- List of Unified Payments Interface applications: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Unified_Payments_Interface_applications

Narration is a synthetic voice. Script and visuals are produced with AI tools and checked by automated quality gates.

meta.topic: UPI Transaction Failed? Ye 3 Steps Mein Paise Wapas Aayenge

scenes.say: UPI transaction fail ho jaye toh kya karein? Pehle sixty second mein yeh karo.
Sabse pehle, apne app mein transaction status check karo.
NPCI aur banks ke rules ke mutabik, failed amount automatically account mein wapas aata hai.

show.title: Automatic Refund Rules
items: Bank ki taraf se auto refund

scenes.say: Agar paise instant wapas nahi aaye, toh apne bank ya UPI app par complaint raise karo.
August twenty twenty-five mein UPI ne twenty billion transactions process kiye, toh system busy ho sakta hai.
Toh ghabrana nahi hai, bas thoda wait karo aur status track karo.
